domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains users can put their routes under. HTTP ports become Pangolin resources, TCP ports get a Cloudflare SRV record — the Cloudflare zone is looked up by domain name when you add it. A private domain is only offered to the projects you grant it to.
domains.backendNotConfigured: Neither route backend is configured. Add <code1>[routes.cloudflare]</code1> for TCP routes (SRV records) or <code2>[routes.pangolin]</code2> for HTTP routes to the backend config.

routes.description: Every route created under this domain, across all projects.
routes.empty: No routes on this domain yet.

createDialog.title: New domain

createDialog.pangolinIdHelp: The domain's ID in Pangolin. Required for HTTP routes; TCP routes go through Cloudflare, whose zone is resolved from the domain name.
createDialog.httpsHelp: Users may enable HTTPS for HTTP routes on this domain.
createDialog.privateHelp: Only granted projects see this domain.
